name: Hyundai / Kia automatic transmission controller (classic CAN, TCU11-TCU13 broadcast)
notes: The TCU broadcast frames of opendbc's hyundai_can.dbc (the DBC opendbc uses for every non-CAN-FD Hyundai / Kia / Genesis platform). 'vehicles' lists the platforms whose gear opendbc reads from TCU12 (flag TCU_GEARS in car/hyundai/values.py); other platforms of that DBC may send the frames too, which the source does not say. Signal meanings beyond the DBC names and scales are not documented upstream and are marked so per signal; checksums are not verified. No gearbox codes, part numbers or flash layout are claimed: there is no open source for them, so identify is empty and the definition is chosen by id. The UDS channel is untested (validation: implemented).

diagnostics.name: uds
diagnostics.notes: Request id from opendbc car/hyundai/fingerprints.py (Ecu.transmission 0x7E1), response = request + 8 (ISO 15765-4, opendbc's default rx_offset). 22 F100 is the 'long description' identification opendbc's firmware query sends (HYUNDAI_VERSION_REQUEST_LONG). Not tried on a car.

buses.name: ccan
buses.description: Hyundai / Kia classic CAN (C-CAN) as opendbc's hyundai_can.dbc describes it
buses.notes: 500 kbit/s is assumed (the OBD-II CAN rate of ISO 15765-4); opendbc does not state bus rates.

signals.name: TQI_TCU_INC
signals.notes: Torque-increase request to the engine, in % (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: G_SEL_DISP
signals.notes: Selector position for the cluster display. opendbc has no value table for it, so raw values are shown as numbers.

signals.name: F_TCU
signals.notes: TCU fault/status field (2 bits); meaning not documented in the source.

signals.name: TCU_TYPE
signals.notes: TCU type (2 bits); values not documented in the source.

signals.name: TCU_OBD
signals.notes: TCU OBD status (3 bits); values not documented in the source.

signals.name: SWI_GS
signals.notes: Gear-select switch flag (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: GEAR_TYPE
signals.notes: Gearbox type (4 bits); values not documented in the source.

signals.name: TQI_TCU
signals.notes: Torque request to the engine, in % (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: TEMP_AT
signals.notes: Automatic-transmission fluid temperature, raw - 40 (DBC unit 'deg', read as degC).

signals.name: N_TC
signals.notes: Torque-converter turbine speed (raw x 0.25).

signals.name: SWI_CC
signals.notes: Cruise-control related switch (2 bits); values not documented in the source.

signals.name: CF_Tcu_Alive1
signals.notes: Alive counter.

signals.name: CF_Tcu_ChkSum1
signals.notes: Checksum nibble (algorithm not documented in the source; not verified).

frames.name: TCU12
frames.notes: TCU status 2 (hyundai_can.dbc). opendbc reads the current gear from CUR_GR on platforms with its TCU_GEARS flag.

signals.name: ETL_TCU
signals.notes: Engine torque limit requested by the TCU (raw x 2 Nm).

signals.name: CUR_GR
signals.notes: Current gear. opendbc's value table names 0 P, 1-8 D and 14 R; the forward gear number is kept in the name here (D1..D8).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_Alive
signals.notes: Alive counter.

signals.name: CF_Tcu_ChkSum
signals.notes: Checksum (2 bits; algorithm not documented in the source).

signals.name: VS_TCU
signals.notes: Vehicle speed seen by the TCU, whole km/h (VS_TCU_DECIMAL adds the fraction).

signals.name: FUEL_CUT_TCU
signals.notes: Fuel-cut request (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: INH_FUEL_CUT
signals.notes: Fuel-cut inhibit (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: IDLE_UP_TCU
signals.notes: Idle-up request (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: N_INC_TCU
signals.notes: Engine-speed increase request (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: SPK_RTD_TCU
signals.notes: Spark-retard request (raw x 0.375 - 23.625; the DBC gives no unit).

signals.name: N_TC_RAW
signals.notes: Turbine speed, unfiltered (raw x 0.25).

signals.name: VS_TCU_DECIMAL
signals.notes: Fractional part of the vehicle speed (raw / 128 km/h).

signals.name: N_TGT_LUP
signals.notes: Target lock-up speed (raw x 10 + 500 rpm; meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: SLOPE_TCU
signals.notes: Road slope estimated by the TCU (raw x 0.5 - 16 %).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_TarGr
signals.notes: Target gear (4 bits; no value table in the source).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_ShfPatt
signals.notes: Shift pattern / drive mode (4 bits; no value table in the source).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_TqGrdLim
signals.notes: Torque-gradient limit (raw x 10 Nm/s).

signals.name: CR_Tcu_IsgTgtRPM
signals.notes: Idle stop-and-go target engine speed (raw x 20 rpm).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_SptRdy
signals.notes: Sport mode ready (meaning from the DBC name).

signals.name: CF_Tcu_Alive3
signals.notes: Alive counter.

signals.name: CF_Tcu_ChkSum3
signals.notes: Checksum nibble (algorithm not documented in the source).

safety: OpenTune only listens to these broadcast frames (and, where a diagnostic channel is listed, reads identification); it never writes to this controller.
Do not transmit on a drivetrain CAN bus of a moving car: these frames feed the engine, brakes and instrument cluster. Log with a listen-only adapter.
